hooks.command: $raw=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $d=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json; $f=$d.tool_input.file_path; $ext=if($f){[IO.Path]::GetExtension($f).ToLower()}else{''}; $skip=@('.md','.json','.txt','.xml','.yaml','.yml','.toml','.ini','.cfg','.gitignore','.editorconfig',''); if($f -and $skip -notcontains $ext){ echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Code file modified. Before finishing: run automated tests (build_dotnet_app for .NET/.cs changes, run_ahk_tests for .ahk changes). If UI or visual rendering changed, also run screenshot tests via the render test infrastructure (RenderHelper)."}}'  }

$raw=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $d=$raw|ConvertFrom-Json; $f=$d.tool_input.file_path; if($f){ git ls-files --error-unmatch $f 2>&1 | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ git check-ignore -q $f 2>&1 | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ Write-Output '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"New untracked file created. Ask the user whether it should be added to .gitignore."}}' } } }
